elements.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without Vendor consent, unqualified
elements.evidence: "without the prior approval of TrueLink, to a financially responsible affiliate" — the affiliate right remains gated by a financial-responsibility qualification

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations ... without the prior written approval of Client"

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld"

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "and in no event to a competitor of Client"

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate, re-price or modify this Agreement"

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors
elements.evidence: Vendor-side assignment is consent-gated with no successor carve-out: "TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations ... without the prior written approval of Client"
No notice mechanic appears; Customer assigns "without the prior approval of TrueLink" with no notice obligation

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld"

offending_extra_words: or of the business to which this Agreement relates
and its rights and obligations hereunder
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the consent-free affiliate assignment is still conditioned on the affiliate being "financially responsible", which is a qualification the preferred position does not permit; delete that qualifier.
Fallback is also not satisfied on its own terms: there is no mutual successor-assignment right for TrueLink and no written-notice mechanic, so the two levels cannot be blended.

Minimality fails: the edit rewrites the whole 37-word mutual sentence into 123 words (ratio 3.32) with added scope words ("reorganization", "or of the business to which this Agreement relates", "re-price or modify") beyond what the preferred position requires; a tighter edit plus a short change-of-control insertion would suffice.
Intent is preserved: no unrelated term is disturbed, no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
